passives.name: Haze of Mana
passives.description: When hit by an AoE attack, grants self a Barrier for [Buff_T_4004005_4_3_2] turns. If current HP exceeds 85%, damage dealt to enemies increases by 100%. Non-Fire enemies’ Attack and Effectiveness are reduced by 50%, and damage taken from non-Fire enemies is reduced by 80%.
